demo.title: Future features
demo.subtitle: Interactive demonstrations of capabilities that are not yet delivered by the browser-only MVP.
demo.banner: Demo mode — sample data only. Nothing here contacts emergency services or monitors a real trip.
demo.sampleNotice: All values on this page are sample data unless explicitly labelled live. They are not a current forecast, official alert, or operational facility.
demo.roadmap.title: Roadmap status
demo.roadmap.caption: Count of Dala Safe capabilities by current status.
demo.notFoundBody: The demonstration you opened is not part of this build. Return to the list to pick another.
demo.future.resetHint: Clears any local demo notes stored by these demonstrations on this device. Trips and settings are not touched.
demo.future.resetDone: Local demo data cleared on this device.
demo.route.title: Advanced route planning
demo.route.lead: Pick a sample route and edit its elevation samples to see how a distance, ascent and elevation-profile panel could behave.
demo.route.summary: Editable sample routes with a computed SVG elevation profile, distance and ascent readouts.
demo.route.elevations.hint: 2 to 40 numbers, for example: 2500, 2800, 3100. Editing redraws the profile.
demo.route.elevations.invalid: Enter 2 to 40 numbers separated by commas (each between -100 and 9000).
demo.route.chart.title: Elevation profile
demo.route.chart.alt: Sample elevation profile with {points} points, from {min} to {max} metres.
demo.route.chart.sampleNote: Profile drawn from the sample values above — not from a surveyed track.
demo.route.chart.hidden: The profile is hidden until the elevation samples are valid.
demo.route.productionNote: Surveyed GPX tracks, an authoritative elevation model, and a route dataset maintained with local clubs or authorities. Nothing here is survey-grade.
demo.weather.title: Trip weather panel
demo.weather.lead: A three-day sample forecast with wind, precipitation and hazard rows, switched with the day buttons.
demo.weather.summary: Three-day sample weather with a day switcher and sample hazard alerts — not a live forecast.
demo.weather.banner.title: Sample data — not a live forecast
demo.weather.banner.body: These values are invented for the demo. In production the panel would need Kazhydromet or another official weather API, with attribution and licence compliance.
demo.weather.hazards.title: Hazard alerts (sample)
demo.weather.hazards.note: Illustrative alerts for the selected sample day. An official service would list an issuing authority, valid times and areas.
demo.weather.hazards.disclaimer: These are not official warnings and must not be relied on.
demo.weather.hazard.none: No sample hazard alerts for this day.
demo.weather.hazard.avalanche.title: Avalanche risk (sample)
demo.weather.hazard.avalanche.body: Sample wording: elevated avalanche risk on steep north-facing slopes above 3000 m after recent snowfall.
demo.weather.hazard.storm.title: Wind and precipitation (sample)
demo.weather.hazard.storm.body: Sample wording: strong wind with snow expected on ridges; exposed sections may become impassable.
demo.weather.productionNote: A licensed feed such as Kazhydromet, cached forecasts with clear timestamps, licensing and attribution, and expert rules for turning data into practical trip advice.
demo.risk.title: Regional risk summary
demo.risk.lead: Sample zones around the Almaty region with a filterable risk level. Illustration of a summary layout only.
demo.risk.summary: Filterable list of Almaty-region sample zones with risk levels — not operational facilities.
demo.risk.notFacility.title: Sample locations — not operational facilities
demo.risk.notFacility.body: These zone names and levels are invented for layout purposes. They are NOT monitoring stations, official zones, or places you should navigate by.
demo.risk.emptyBody: Choose another risk level to see sample zones.
demo.risk.zone.bigAlmaty.condition: Sample note: lingering snow cover on northern aspects; popular approach busy on weekends.
demo.risk.zone.talgar.condition: Sample note: strong ridge wind and poor visibility in this invented scenario.
demo.risk.zone.kolsai.condition: Sample note: trails passable in this invented scenario; cold nights near the upper lake.
demo.risk.zone.charyn.condition: Sample note: heat exposure in open sections; limited shade in this invented scenario.
demo.risk.zone.ileAlatau.condition: Sample note: mixed conditions near the treeline in this invented scenario.
demo.risk.productionNote: Official hazard feeds, verified zone geometry, update timestamps, and a clear liability disclaimer — agreed with the responsible services.
demo.group.title: Shared trip board
demo.group.lead: A sample board where each member has a status you can advance: planning, in transit, checked in, overdue.
demo.group.summary: Shared-trip board with advanceable member statuses (planning, in transit, checked in, overdue) — simulated only.
demo.group.simulated.title: Simulated — no server
demo.group.simulated.body: Statuses live in this page only and change when you press a control. Nothing is shared with other people and nothing runs in the background.
demo.group.memberSampleNote: Sample member — not a real person.
demo.group.resetDone: All sample statuses reset to planning.
demo.group.updatedAll: All sample members advanced one status.
demo.group.idle: Press a control to change a status.
demo.group.productionNote: A backend with accounts, real-time sync, explicit consent from every member, notification delivery, and clear rules for who can see location or status data.
demo.learning.title: First-aid and survival learning
demo.learning.lead: Three sample lesson outlines with a reviewed toggle, to show how a learning section could be structured.
demo.learning.summary: Three sample first-aid/survival lesson outlines with a mark-reviewed toggle — content needs expert review.
demo.learning.expertNote.title: Not certified medical advice
demo.learning.expertNote.body: These outlines are placeholders. Production content must be written and reviewed by qualified first-aid instructors and doctors before anyone relies on it.
demo.learning.lesson.hypothermia.title: Keeping a casualty warm (sample outline)
demo.learning.lesson.hypothermia.body: Sample outline: stop exposure, remove wet layers, insulate from the ground, and monitor breathing — details to be confirmed by experts.
demo.learning.lesson.bleeding.title: Direct pressure for bleeding (sample outline)
demo.learning.lesson.bleeding.body: Sample outline: apply firm direct pressure with a dressing and seek emergency help — details to be confirmed by experts.
demo.learning.lesson.navigation.title: Stopping when lost (sample outline)
demo.learning.lesson.navigation.body: Sample outline: stop, assess surroundings, use a map and compass or an offline track, and signal your position — details to be confirmed by experts.
demo.learning.productionNote: A reviewed curriculum with named expert authors, versioning, offline packaging, and a clear statement that the app does not replace instruction or medical care.
demo.checkin.title: Missed check-in escalation
demo.checkin.lead: Step through a simulated missed check-in to see how an escalation notice to a trusted contact could be prepared.
demo.checkin.summary: Interactive missed-check-in timeline that drafts a trusted-contact notice labelled Requires integration — nothing is transmitted.
demo.checkin.simulated.title: Simulated timeline — nothing runs in the background
demo.checkin.simulated.body: Each step appears only when you press a control. This demo has no scheduler, no background service, and no connection to any messaging system.
demo.checkin.step.scheduled.title: Check-in scheduled (sample)
demo.checkin.step.scheduled.body: Sample scenario: the trip plan says a check-in is due at 18:00.
demo.checkin.step.missed.title: Check-in missed (sample)
demo.checkin.step.missed.body: Sample scenario: the check-in window has passed with no reply from the traveler.
demo.checkin.step.draft.title: Escalation draft: SMS the trusted contact
demo.checkin.step.draft.body: Draft prepared for your review: “A check-in was missed on a sample trip. This is demo text.” Nothing leaves this device and no SMS is transmitted.
demo.checkin.productionNote: An SMS gateway or messaging provider, scheduled background checks with a battery-aware design, explicit user consent, carrier rules, and a documented failure mode when the network is unavailable.
demo.satellite.title: Mesh SOS relay and satellite roadmap
demo.satellite.lead: A sample device mesh, a store-and-forward queue, and an unverified roadmap for satellite and official integrations.
demo.satellite.summary: Sample mesh diagram, store-and-forward message queue, and an unverified satellite/official-integration roadmap — no connection is made.
demo.satellite.banner.title: No radio, no satellite link — sample only
demo.satellite.banner.body: The browser cannot reach mesh radios or satellite modems. Everything below is an illustration; the app makes no satellite connection.
demo.satellite.mesh.title: Sample device mesh
demo.satellite.meshNote: Illustrative mesh of sample devices. In production, real relay hardware and spectrum rules would apply.
demo.satellite.mesh.alt: Sample mesh diagram: your device relays through the selected device and then to the exit node. Path: {path}
demo.satellite.pathNote: Illustrative path only — no message travels this route in the demo.
demo.satellite.queue.title: Store-and-forward queue
demo.satellite.queueNote: Messages wait here until a real link exists. In this demo nothing is transmitted anywhere.
demo.satellite.queue.label: Message text
demo.satellite.queue.hint: Stored in this page only — not on a device radio.
demo.satellite.queue.sampleText: Sample SOS: need help at coordinates (demo text)
demo.satellite.queue.entry: Queued at {time} (sample clock) — waiting for a link that does not exist here
demo.satellite.roadmap.title: Satellite and official-integration roadmap
demo.satellite.roadmapNote: Planned directions only. Every row is unverified and no partnership is claimed.
demo.satellite.roadmap.requires: Requires integration / unverified — no partnership claimed
demo.satellite.roadmap.eqonaq.title: eQonaq registration linkage
demo.satellite.roadmap.eqonaq.body: Possible direction: link a trip plan with a tourist registration system such as eQonaq, subject to an official agreement.
demo.satellite.roadmap.hydromet.title: Kazhydromet data feed
demo.satellite.roadmap.hydromet.body: Possible direction: licensed weather and warning data with attribution.
demo.satellite.roadmap.rescue.title: Rescue service notifications
demo.satellite.roadmap.rescue.body: Possible direction: a documented channel to the responsible rescue service — requires their agreement and a tested procedure.
demo.satellite.roadmap.satellite.title: Satellite messenger partnership
demo.satellite.roadmap.satellite.body: Possible direction: integration with a satellite messenger or store-and-forward provider; no vendor is selected or endorsed.
demo.satellite.productionNote: Certified radio or satellite hardware, spectrum and carrier compliance, backend infrastructure for queued messages, and signed agreements with each official partner.
